other_conditions: Worker must be employed in an establishment registered under the Factories Act, 1948
Monthly salary (basic salary + dearness allowance) must not exceed ₹15,000 per month
Application can be made 3 months before or up to 1 year after the scheduled date of the girl's marriage
Benefit payable only for the marriage of a worker or two daughters
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹51,000 per eligible marriage.
documents_required: Scanned copy of the verified application form
